step1_analysis.description: A fully differential two-stage amplifier utilizing telescopic cascode topologies for both the first and second stages. It features NMOS input pairs, PMOS cascode active loads, and dummy NMOS transistors (XM19, XM20) acting as grounded load capacitors for compensation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Two telescopic cascode stages. Stage 1 gain ≈ gm * (gm*ro^2) ≈ 40-50 dB. Stage 2 gain ≈ 40-50 dB. Total expected gain = 80-100 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 1.8V devices have lower intrinsic gain (gm*ro) than older 5V 0.5µm devices, but cascading two telescopic stages still yields very high gain.

Unity_Gain_Frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop differential gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF ≈ gm1 / (2 * pi * C_load). With gm1 ≈ 1mA/V and parasitic/dummy load capacitance ≈ 50-100fF, UGF can reach several hundred MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Modern 130nm nodes are significantly faster than 0.5µm, so the UGF will likely be higher for the same bias current, depending heavily on the actual load capacitance.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the location of the non-dominant pole relative to the UGF. Typically designed for >60 degrees for stability.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard stability requirement for closed-loop MDAC applications.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD = 1.8V and estimated tail currents of ~100µA per stage, I_total ≈ 200µA. P ≈ 1.8V * 200µA = 0.36 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 720mW figure is for the entire pipeline ADC at 5V. A single residue amplifier in 1.8V Sky130 will consume orders of magnitude less power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure open-loop DC gain, unity gain frequency, phase margin, and DC power consumption. Includes ideal behavioral CMFB to stabilize the high-gain differential operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential Two-Stage Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm19=5u L_xm19=0.5u
.param W_xm20=5u L_xm20=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N10 BIAS3 N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT_PLUS BIAS3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N15 BIAS1 VDDA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT_MINUS BIAS2 N15 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 BIAS3 N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT_PLUS BIAS2 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N10 BIAS2 N16 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 OUT_MINUS BIAS3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N14 IN_MINUS N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N10 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N4 BIAS2 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N13 IN_PLUS N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N3 BIAS1 VDDA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N6 BIAS1 VDDA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N2 N4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N16 BIAS1 VDDA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N9 CM_BIAS1 VSSA GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 N1 CM_BIAS2 VSSA GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM19 N26 VDDA N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm19} w={W_xm19}
XM20 N5 VDDA N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm20} w={W_xm20}

* Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVDDA VDDA 0 1.8
VVSSA VSSA 0 0

* Fixed Biases
VBIAS1 BIAS1 0 1.0
VBIAS2 BIAS2 0 0.6
VBIAS3 BIAS3 0 1.2

* Ideal CMFB for tail currents to set output CM to 0.9V
Bcmfb1 CM_BIAS1 0 V='0.7 + 10*(v(N10)+v(N4)-1.8)'
Bcmfb2 CM_BIAS2 0 V='0.7 + 10*(v(OUT_PLUS)+v(OUT_MINUS)-1.8)'

* Inputs (Differential AC = 1V)
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VIN_PLUS IN_PLUS VCM DC 0 AC 0.5
VIN_MINUS IN_MINUS VCM DC 0 AC -0.5

* Differential Output
Eout OUT_DIFF 0 vol='v(OUT_PLUS)-v(OUT_MINUS)'

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -(i(VVDD) + i(VVDDA)) * 1.8
print power
print v(N10) v(N4) v(OUT_PLUS) v(OUT_MINUS)
print v(CM_BIAS1) v(CM_BIAS2)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Phase margin calculation (assuming non-inverting DC phase = 0)
let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugf
print pm

quit
.endc
